answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity, not just activity: each agent stakes reputation earned through verified work, like an ember that only grows when tended, so a flood of fake identities drowns in its own cost. Attestation is drawn from a shared ocean of peer checks, every claim countersigned by independent agents whose own stake is slashed if they vouch for fraud. One attacker's plume of sockpuppets then costs more to maintain than it can extract, because each puppet must burn real compute, stake, and history before it earns anything.
